data.exact_reserve_text: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves, primarily impacting the 2021 underwriting year. This was calculated from the gross claims development table, showing an increase in the estimated ultimate claims for that year. General factors such as the rapidly changing cyber risk environment, rate changes, and inflation are noted as contributing to overall claims uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: rapidly changing environment in the cyber class of business has a higher degree of uncertainty due to the propensity for changes to the cyber risk landscape and perils, such as ransomware emerging in the past couple of years
Loss estimates are heavily influenced by expected loss ratios on which there is a high level of uncertainty
Continued focus remained on inflation throughout 2023 due to the continuing war in Ukraine as well as other supply side issues
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 16, considering only underwriting years older than the two most recent (2023 and 2022).
